zh.title: 规则中文译本
zh.url: https://rules.wfdf.sport/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/01-WFDF世界飞盘联合会飞盘规则（2025-2028）中文版.pdf

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: Ultimate is a non-contact, self-officiated sport. All players are responsible for administering and adhering to the rules. Ultimate relies upon a Spirit of the Game that places the responsibility for fair play on every player.
entries.zh: 团队飞盘是一项无身体接触、自我裁判的运动。所有队员都有责任执行并遵守规则。团队飞盘依靠“飞盘精神”，将公平竞争的责任赋予每一位队员。

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: It is trusted that no player will intentionally break the rules; thus there are no harsh penalties for inadvertent breaches, but rather a method for resuming play in a manner which simulates what would most likely have occurred had there been no breach.
entries.zh: 团队飞盘运动相信没有队员会故意违反规则，因此对于无意的违反规则的行为，不会施加严厉的处罚，而是通过一种方式恢复比赛，这种方式模拟如果没有违规时比赛最可能出现的情况。

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: If there is a deliberate or egregious breach of the rules or Spirit of the Game, the captains should discuss this and determine an appropriate outcome, even if that outcome is not in accordance with a specific rule.
entries.zh: 如果发生故意或严重违反规则或飞盘精神的行为，双方队长应展开讨论并确定适当的处理结果，即使该结果并不符合具体规则。

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: Players should be mindful of the fact that they are acting as referees in any arbitration between teams. Players must:
entries.zh: 队员们需谨记，在双方需要仲裁时，他们实际扮演了裁判的角色。因此，场上队员必须：

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: know and abide by both the rules and the spirit of the rules;
entries.zh: 熟悉并遵守规则及飞盘精神的规定；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: be fair-minded and objective;
entries.zh: 公正客观；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: be truthful;
entries.zh: 诚实；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: explain their viewpoint clearly and briefly;
entries.zh: 清晰简练地阐明自己的观点；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: allow opponents an opportunity to speak;
entries.zh: 给对手发言的机会；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: listen to and consider opponent’s viewpoint;
entries.zh: 倾听并考虑对手的观点；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: use respectful words and body language with consideration of potential cultural differences;
entries.zh: 使用尊重的语言和肢体表达，并考虑潜在的文化差异；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: resolve disputes efficiently;
entries.zh: 高效解决争议；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: make calls in a consistent manner throughout the game; and
entries.zh: 在整场比赛中以一致的方式进行示意；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: only make a call where a breach is significant enough to make a difference to the outcome of the action, or where a player’s safety is at risk.
entries.zh: 仅在违规行为对结果产生显著影响或对场上队员安全构成威胁时作出示意。

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: Highly competitive play is encouraged, but should never sacrifice the mutual respect between players, adherence to the agreed-upon rules of the game, player safety or the basic joy of play.
entries.zh: 团队飞盘运动鼓励高水平竞技，但不能以牺牲队员之间的相互尊重、破坏比赛规则、队员安全或比赛的乐趣为代价。

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: The following actions are some examples of good Spirit:
entries.zh: 以下是一些良好飞盘精神的示例：

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: retracting a call when you no longer believe the call was correct;
entries.zh: 在认为示意不正确时主动撤回示意；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: checking in with an opponent on the sideline after a contentious interaction;
entries.zh: 在场下继续和对手化解场上产生的争议；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: complimenting an opponent for good play or Spirit;
entries.zh: 赞扬对手的优秀表现或良好的飞盘精神；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: introducing yourself to your opponent; and
entries.zh: 向对手做自我介绍；并

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: reacting calmly towards disagreement or provocation.
entries.zh: 冷静地应对分歧或挑衅。

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: The following actions are clear violations of the Spirit of the Game and must be avoided:
entries.zh: 以下行为明显违反飞盘精神，必须避免：

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: dangerous play and aggressive behaviour;
entries.zh: 危险动作和攻击性行为；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: intentional fouling or other intentional rule breaches;
entries.zh: 故意犯规或其他故意违反规则的行为；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: taunting or intimidating opposing players;
entries.zh: 嘲讽或恐吓对手；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: celebrating disrespectfully after scoring;
entries.zh: 无礼的得分庆祝行为；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: making calls in retaliation to an opponent’s call;
entries.zh: 为了报复对手的示意而进行示意；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: calling for a pass from an opposition player; and
entries.zh: 误导对手给自己传盘；以及

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: other win-at-all-costs behaviour.
entries.zh: 其他“为了获胜而不择手段”的行为。

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: Teams are guardians of the Spirit of the Game, and must:
entries.zh: 队伍是飞盘精神的守护者，必须：

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: take responsibility for teaching their team the rules and good Spirit;
entries.zh: 负责教导他们队伍的队员规则和良好的飞盘精神；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: discipline team-mates who display poor Spirit;
entries.zh: 约束飞盘精神欠佳的队友；

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: provide constructive feedback to other teams about what they are doing well and/or how to improve their adherence to the Spirit of the Game; and
entries.zh: 向对手提供关于他们做得好的方面或如何改进他们遵守比赛精神的建设性反馈；向其他队伍提供建设性反馈，关于他们做的好的方面和/或如何更好地遵守飞盘精神；以及

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: call a Spirit Stoppage to address Spirit issues, as appropriate.
entries.zh: 酌情示意精神暂停，处理与飞盘精神相关的问题。

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: In the case where a novice player is involved in a breach and does not know the rules, experienced players should assist to explain the breach.
entries.zh: 如果新手队员涉及违反规则且不了解规则，有经验的队员应协助向其解释违规原因。

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: An experienced player, who offers advice on rules and guides on-field arbitration, may supervise games involving beginners or younger players.
entries.zh: 一名经验丰富的队员，可监督有初学者或年轻队员参与的比赛，并就规则及现场仲裁提供建议。

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: Calls should be discussed by the players directly involved in the play, and by players who had the best perspective on the play.
entries.zh: 示意应由直接涉及的双方场上队员，以及具有最佳视角的场上队员共同讨论。

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: If a player who was not directly involved believes that a team-mate has made an incorrect call, or caused a foul or violation, they should inform their team-mate.
entries.zh: 如果一名非直接相关队员认为队友做出了错误的示意，或造成了犯规或违例，则应提醒其队友。

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: Non-players, apart from the captains, should refrain from getting involved. However players may seek other peoples' perspectives to clarify the rules, and to assist players to make the appropriate call.
entries.zh: 除了队长之外的非场上队员应避免参与讨论，但场上队员可以寻求其他人的观点来澄清规则，并帮助队员做出适当的示意。

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: Players and captains are solely responsible for making and resolving all calls.
entries.zh: 场上队员和队长对所有示意的做出和解决负全部责任。

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: If after discussion players cannot agree, or it is not clear and obvious: the disc must be returned to the last non-disputed thrower.
entries.zh: 如果在讨论后队员仍无法达成一致意见，或者无法清晰明确地判断：

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: what occurred in a play, or
entries.zh: 比赛中发生的情况，或

entries.title: 飞盘精神
entries.en: what would most likely have occurred in a play,
entries.zh: 如果没有争议的情况下，比赛最可能会发生的情况，则飞盘必须回到最后一位无争议的持盘队员手中。

entries.title: 比赛场地
entries.en: The playing field is a rectangular area with dimensions and zones as shown on Figure 1 (see above) and should be essentially flat, free of obstructions and afford reasonable player safety.
entries.zh: 比赛场地为长方形区域，尺寸和区域如图 1 所示。场地应尽量平坦，无障碍物，并能为队员提供合理的安全保障。图 1 团队飞盘比赛场地

entries.title: 比赛场地
entries.en: The perimeter lines surround the playing field and consist of two (2) sidelines along the length and two (2) endlines along the width.
entries.zh: 场地边界线围绕着比赛场地，由两条沿着长度的边线和两条沿着宽度的端线组成。

entries.title: 比赛场地
entries.en: The perimeter lines are not part of the playing field.
entries.zh: 边界线不属于比赛场地的一部分。

entries.title: 比赛场地
entries.en: The goal lines are the lines that separate the central zone from the end zones and are part of the central zone.
entries.zh: 得分线将中心区与得分区分隔开，且属于中心区的一部分。

entries.title: 比赛场地
entries.en: The brick marks are the intersection of two (2) crossed one (1) metre lines in the central zone, located a distance equal to the length of the end zone away from each goal line, midway between the sidelines.
entries.zh: 砖点是中心区内两条相交的 1 米长线段的交点，砖点与得分线的距离等于得分区长度，并位于两条边线的中点位置。

entries.title: 比赛场地
entries.en: Eight brightly-coloured, flexible objects (such as plastic cones) mark the corners of the central zone and the end zones.
entries.zh: 八个颜色鲜艳的柔性物体（如塑料角标）用于标记中心区和得分区的角点。

entries.title: 比赛场地
entries.en: The immediate surroundings of the playing field shall be kept clear of movable objects. If play is obstructed by non-players or objects within three (3) metres of the perimeter line, any obstructed player or thrower in possession may call “Violation”.
entries.zh: 比赛场地周围的区域应保持无移动物体。如果比赛被边界线 3 米内的非场上队员或物体阻碍，任何受影响的场上队员或持盘队员都可以示意“违例”。

entries.title: 比赛装备
entries.en: Any flying disc acceptable to both captains may be used.
entries.zh: 比赛可使用双方队长都认可的飞盘。

entries.title: 比赛装备
entries.en: WFDF may maintain a list of approved discs recommended for use.
entries.zh: 世界飞盘联合会会提供一份推荐使用的认证飞盘清单。

entries.title: 比赛装备
entries.en: Each player must wear a uniform that distinguishes their team.
entries.zh: 队员必须穿着能够区分他们队伍的统一服装。

entries.title: 比赛装备
entries.en: No player may wear items of clothing or equipment that reasonably could harm the wearer or other players, or impede an opponent's ability to play.
entries.zh: 任何队员不得穿戴可能伤害自己或他人，或妨碍对手比赛发挥的服装或装备。

entries.title: 回合 ，得分与比赛
entries.en: A game consists of a number of points. Each point ends with the scoring of a goal.
entries.zh: 一场比赛由若干个回合组成。每个回合以得分结束。

entries.title: 回合 ，得分与比赛
entries.en: A game is finished and won by the first team to score fifteen (15) goals.
entries.zh: 当有队伍首先获得 15 分时，比赛结束，该队获胜。

entries.title: 回合 ，得分与比赛
entries.en: A game is separated into two (2) periods of play, called halves. Half time occurs when a team first scores eight (8) goals.
entries.zh: 比赛分为两个阶段，称为上下半场。中场休息发生在任意一队得分先获得 8 分时。

entries.title: 回合 ，得分与比赛
entries.en: The first point of each half starts when the half starts.
entries.zh: 每个半场的开始也是当前半场首个回合的开始。

entries.title: 回合 ，得分与比赛
entries.en: After a goal is scored, and the game has not been won or half time has not been reached:
entries.zh: 每当得分后，且比赛未结束或未到半场时限时：

entries.title: 回合 ，得分与比赛
entries.en: the next point starts immediately;
entries.zh: 下一个回合立即开始；

entries.title: 回合 ，得分与比赛
entries.en: the teams switch the end zone that they are defending; and
entries.zh: 双方交换防守的得分区；

entries.title: 回合 ，得分与比赛
entries.en: the team that scored becomes defence and pulls next.
entries.zh: 得分队伍成为防守方，并进行下一回合开盘。

entries.title: 队伍
entries.en: Each team will put a maximum of seven (7) players and a minimum of five (5) players on the field during each point.
entries.zh: 每队每回合上场的队员数量最多为 7 人，最少为 5 人。

entries.title: 队伍
entries.en: Each team must designate a captain and a spirit captain to represent the team.
entries.zh: 每支队伍必须指定一名队长和一名精神队长代表队伍。

entries.title: 队伍
entries.en: A team may make unlimited substitutions after a goal is scored and before their team signals readiness for the pull.
entries.zh: 队伍在得分后，且在示意准备好开盘前，可以进行无限制的队员替换。

entries.title: 队伍
entries.en: For Mixed games, a form of an alternating 4:3 personnel ratio should be used.
entries.zh: 对于混合组比赛，应使用交替的 4:3 性别比例。

entries.title: 开始比赛
entries.en: Representatives of the two teams fairly determine which team first chooses either:
entries.zh: 两队代表应公正地决定哪支队伍首先选择以下内容之一：

entries.title: 开始比赛
entries.en: whether to receive or throw the initial pull; or
entries.zh: 首先投掷开盘或接收开盘；或

entries.title: 开始比赛
entries.en: which end zone they will initially defend.
entries.zh: 首先防守哪一侧得分区。

entries.title: 开始比赛
entries.en: The other team is given the remaining choice.
entries.zh: 另一队则获得剩余的选择权。

entries.title: 开始比赛
entries.en: At the start of the second half, these initial selections are switched.
entries.zh: 在下半场开始时，上半场的初始选择将会交换。

entries.title: 开始比赛
entries.en: For Mixed games, teams should discuss any strategies to make personnel match-ups easier to identify.
entries.zh: 对于混合组比赛，两支队伍应该决定一种方法以便于识别队伍的性别配置。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: At the start of the game, after half-time or after a score, play commences with a throw by the defence, called a “pull”.
entries.zh: 在比赛开始时、中场休息后或得分后，比赛通过防守方的一次飞盘投掷开始，这称之为 “开盘”。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: Teams must prepare for the pull without unreasonable delay.
entries.zh: 队伍必须在规定时间内开盘，不得无故拖延。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: The pull may be made only after both teams have signalled their readiness by having the puller and a player on offence raise a hand above their head.
entries.zh: 只有在两队都示意准备就绪之后，才能开盘。开盘队员需要单手举过头顶进行示意，进攻方需要至少有一人单手举过头顶进行示意。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: After signalling readiness all offensive players must stand with one foot on their defending goal line without changing location relative to one another until the pull is released.
entries.zh: 在示意准备就绪后，所有进攻队员必须有一只脚站在防守得分区的得分线上，且不得改变彼此相对位置，直到开盘被释放。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: After signalling readiness all defensive players must keep their feet entirely behind the vertical plane of the goal line until the pull is released.
entries.zh: 在示意准备就绪后，所有防守方队员必须保持双脚完全站在得分后，直到飞盘发出，直到开盘被释放。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: If a team breaches 7.3 (“false start”) or 7.4 (“offside”) the opposing team may call the relevant violation. This must be called before the offence touches the disc (7.8 still applies).
entries.zh: 如果某队违反 7.3（“错误启动”）或 7.4（“越线”），对方队伍可示意对应违例。这必须在进攻方接触飞盘前示意（7.8 条仍适用）。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: If the defence chooses to call a false start, the thrower must establish a pivot point as per 7.9, 7.10, 7.11, or 7.12 and then play restarts as soon as possible as if a time-out had been called at that location.
entries.zh: 如果防守方选择示意错误启动，持盘队员必须按 7.9、7.10、7.11 或 7.12 条来确定轴心点，然后应像在该位置的暂停结束后一样尽快重新开始比赛。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: If the offence chooses to call offside, they must let the disc hit the ground untouched and then resume play as if a brick has been called (no check is required).
entries.zh: 如果进攻方示意越线，进攻方不能在飞盘落地前触碰飞盘，然后像示意了“砖点 ”一样恢复比赛（无需验盘）。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: As soon as the pull is released, all players may move in any direction.
entries.zh: 一旦开盘被释放，所有队员可以朝任意方向移动。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: No player on the defensive team may touch the disc after a pull until a member of the offensive team contacts the disc or the disc hits the ground.
entries.zh: 开盘后，防守队员在进攻队员触盘或飞盘触地前不得触盘。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: If an offensive player, in-bounds or out-of-bounds, touches the disc before it hits the ground, and the offensive team fails to subsequently establish possession, that is a turnover (a “dropped pull”).
entries.zh: 如果进攻方队员在飞盘落地之前触碰飞盘，无论在界内或界外，随后并未控制住飞盘，则视为攻防转换（“接开盘掉盘”）。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: If an offensive player catches the pull and subsequently establishes possession, they must establish a pivot point at the location on the playing field nearest to where possession is established, even if that pivot point is in their defending end zone.
entries.zh: 如果进攻队员接住开盘并随后建立盘权，他们必须在比赛场地上最近的确立盘权的位置建立轴心点，即使该轴心点位于他们防守的得分区内。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: If the disc initially contacts the playing field and never becomes out-of-bounds, the thrower must establish a pivot point where the disc stops, even if that pivot point is in their defending end zone.
entries.zh: 如果飞盘首次接触比赛场地并且从未出界，持盘队员必须在飞盘停下的位置建立轴心点，即使该轴心点位于他们防守的得分区内。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: If the disc initially contacts the playing field and then becomes out-of-bounds without contacting an offensive player, the thrower must establish a pivot point where the disc first crossed the perimeter line, or the nearest location in the central zone if that pivot point would be in their defending end zone.
entries.zh: 如果飞盘首次接触比赛场地后，在未接触进攻队员的情况下出界，持盘队员必须在飞盘首先穿过场地边界线的位置建立轴心点，或者如果该轴心点位于他们防守的得分区内，则在离该位置最近的中心区位置建立轴心点。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: If the disc does contact an offensive player before it becomes out-of-bounds the thrower must establish a pivot point where the disc first crossed the perimeter line, even if that pivot point is in their defending end zone.
entries.zh: 如果飞盘在出界前接触了进攻方队员，持盘队员必须在飞盘首次穿过场地边界线的位置建立轴心点，即使该轴心点位于他们防守的得分区内。

entries.title: 开盘
entries.en: If the disc contacts the out-of-bounds area without first touching the playing field or an offensive player, the thrower may establish a pivot point either at the brick mark closest to their defending end zone, or at the location on the central zone closest to where the disc went out-of-bounds (Section 11.8). The binding brick option must be signalled before the disc is picked up. It must be signalled by any offensive player fully extending one arm overhead, and they should call “brick”.
entries.zh: 如果飞盘在没有接触比赛场地或进攻队员的情况下直接出界，持盘队员可以选择在靠近己方防守得分区的砖点或最接近飞盘出界位置的中心区建立轴心点（第 11.8 条）。选择砖点必须在飞盘被捡起之前示意。任何进攻队员都可以通过将一只手臂完全伸展上举过头顶，并喊出“砖点”来示意。

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: Play is 'dead', and no turnover is possible:
entries.zh: 以下情况比赛处于“死盘”状态，不会发生攻防转换：

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: After the start of a point, until the pull is released;
entries.zh: 每个回合开始后，直到开盘被释放；

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: When the disc must be carried to the pivot location after the pull or a turnover, until a pivot point is established;
entries.zh: 在开盘或攻防转换后，飞盘必须带到轴心点位置，直到建立轴心点；

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: After a call which stops the play or any other stoppage, until the disc is checked in; or
entries.zh: 在示意停止或其他中断后，直到验盘前；

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: After a disc hits the ground, until possession is established by the appropriate team.
entries.zh: 飞盘落地后，直到相应队伍建立盘权前。

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: Players are allowed to move during dead play (unless specified otherwise).
entries.zh: 在死盘状态下，队员可以移动（除非另有规定）。

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: Play that is not dead is “live”.
entries.zh: 比赛在非死盘状态下为“活盘”状态。

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: The thrower may not transfer possession of the disc during dead play to another player.
entries.zh: 持盘队员不得在死盘状态下将飞盘转交给其他队员。

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: Any player may attempt to stop a disc from rolling or sliding after it has hit the ground.
entries.zh: 飞盘触地后，任何队员都可以阻止飞盘继续滚动或滑行。

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: If, in attempting to stop such a disc, a player significantly alters the disc’s position, the opposition may request that the pivot point be established at the location where the disc was contacted.
entries.zh: 如果在尝试停止飞盘时，队员明显改变了飞盘的位置，对手可以要求在其接触飞盘的位置建立轴心点。

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: After a turnover, and after the pull, an offensive player must move at walking pace or faster to directly retrieve the disc and establish a pivot point.
entries.zh: 在攻防转换后，以及开盘后，一名进攻队员至少以步行速度直接取回飞盘并建立轴心点。

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: In addition to 8.5, after a turnover the thrower must establish a pivot point within the following time limits, if the disc did not become out-of-bounds, and the disc’s location is:
entries.zh: 除 8.5 条外，在攻防转换后，持盘队员必须在以下时间限制内建立轴心点，如果飞盘未出界，且飞盘位置为：

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: in the central zone – within ten (10) seconds of the disc coming to rest.
entries.zh: 飞盘在中心区——飞盘停止移动后 10 秒内；

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: in an end zone – within twenty (20) seconds of the disc coming to rest.
entries.zh: 飞盘在得分区——飞盘停止移动后 20 秒内。

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: If the offence breaches 8.5, or 8.5.1, the defence may give a warning (“Delay of Game” or using a pre-stall for breaches of 8.5.1) or may call a “Violation”.
entries.zh: 如果进攻方违反 8.5 或 8.5.1 ，防守方可以给予警告（“拖延比赛 ”或违反 8.5.1 后开始预读秒），或可以示意“违例”。

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: If, after a warning, the offence continues to breach 8.5, or 8.5.1, then 9.3.1 does not apply and the marker may commence the stall count.
entries.zh: 如果进攻方在警告后继续违反 8.5 或 8.5.1 ，则 9.3.1 不适用，防盘队员可以直接开始读秒。

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: The defence must not move in a manner that obstructs the offence from taking possession of the disc or establishing a pivot point.
entries.zh: 防守方不得以妨碍进攻方获得盘权或建立轴心点的方式移动。

entries.title: 比赛状态
entries.en: If players cannot agree on the correct pivot location, the relevant midpoint between the two proposed pivot locations must be used.
entries.zh: 如果队员不能就正确的轴心位置达成一致，则必须在两个提议的轴心位置的中点作为轴心点。

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: The marker administers a stall count on the thrower by announcing “Stalling” and then counting from one (1) to ten (10). The interval between the start of each number in the stall count must be at least one (1) second.
entries.zh: 防盘队员通过对持盘队员喊出“读秒”并从 1 数到 10 来进行读秒。每次计数之间的间隔必须至少为 1 秒。

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: The stall count must be clearly communicated to the thrower.
entries.zh: 读秒必须清楚地传达给持盘队员。

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: The marker may only start and continue a stall count when:
entries.zh: 防盘队员只有在以下情况下才能开始和继续读秒：

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: Play is live, or once a pivot point is established after a turnover;
entries.zh: 比赛处于活盘状态，或在攻防转换后一旦建立了轴心点时；

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: They are within three (3) metres of the thrower's pivot point, or the pivot location if the thrower is not at that location; and
entries.zh: 防盘队员在持盘队员轴心点的 3 米范围内；或持盘队员不在轴心点，而防盘队员在轴心点；同时

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: All defenders are legally positioned (Section 18.1).
entries.zh: 所有防守队员都处于合法位置（第 18.1 条）。

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: If the marker moves beyond the appropriate three (3) metre radius, or a different player becomes the marker, the stall count must be restarted at “Stalling one (1)”.
entries.zh: 如果防盘队员移动到持盘队员 3 米之外的位置，或其他防守队员成为防盘队员，读秒必须从“读秒 1”重新开始。

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: After a stoppage in play the stall count is resumed as follows:
entries.zh: 比赛中断后，读秒按以下方式恢复：

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: After an accepted breach by the defence the stall count restarts at “Stalling one (1)”.
entries.zh: 无争议的防守违反规则后，读秒从“读秒 1”重新开始。

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: After an accepted breach by the offence the stall count restarts at maximum nine (9).
entries.zh: 无争议的进攻违反规则后，读秒最高从 9 开始。

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: After a contested stall-out the stall count restarts at “Stalling eight (8)”.
entries.zh: 有争议的读秒超时后，读秒从“读秒 8”重新开始。

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: After continuation of play in accordance with rule 16.3.2 the stall count restarts at “Stalling one (1)”.
entries.zh: 在根据规则 16.3.2 重新开始比赛后，读秒从“读秒 1”重新开始。

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: After all other calls, including “pick”, the stall count restarts at maximum six (6). However:
entries.zh: 在所有其他示意后，包括“阻挡”，读秒最高从 6 开始。但是：

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: If there is a call involving the thrower, and a separate receiving breach, and the disc is returned to the thrower, the stall count is resumed based on the outcome of the call involving the thrower.
entries.zh: 如果示意涉及持盘队员，并且有单独的接盘违反规则行为，且飞盘回到持盘队员手中，读秒将根据持盘队员相关示意的结果恢复。

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: If there is a violation called related to The Check (Section 10), the stall count resumes at the same count that was determined prior to that violation.
entries.zh: 如果涉及与验盘相关的违例（第 10 条），读秒将恢复到该违例之前确定的计数。

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: To restart a stall count “at maximum n”, where “n” is determined by 9.5.2, 9.5.5, or 20.3.6, means the following:
entries.zh: 要重新开始“最大值 n”的读秒，其中“n”由规则 9.5.2、9.5.5 或 20.3.6 确定，那么：

entries.title: 读秒
entries.en: If “x” is the last agreed number fully uttered prior to the call, then the stall count resumes at “Stalling (x plus one)” or “Stalling n”, whichever of those two numbers is lower.
entries.zh: 如果“x”是示意前最后一个完整读出的数字，则读秒从“读秒 x+1”或“读秒 n” 中较小的数字恢复。

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: Whenever play stops during a point for a foul, violation, contested turnover, specified turnover, contested goal, stoppage, discussion, or at the completion of a time-out, play must restart as quickly as possible with a check. The check may only be delayed for the discussion of a call.
entries.zh: 当比赛因犯规、违例、有争议的攻防转换、特定的攻防转换、有争议的得分、比赛中断、讨论或暂停结束时，必须尽快通过验盘重新开始比赛。验盘只能因为讨论示意而延迟。

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: Player positioning after a call (except in the case of a time-out, and unless specified otherwise):
entries.zh: 示意后队员的位置（暂停除外，且除非另有规定）：

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: If play stops before a pass is thrown, all players must return to the location they held when the call was made.
entries.zh: 如果比赛在传盘前停止，所有队员必须回到示意时他们所在的位置。

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: If play stops after a pass is thrown, then:
entries.zh: 如果比赛在传盘后停止，则：

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: if the disc is returned to the thrower, all players must return to the location they held when the thrower released the pass, or the time of the call, whichever is earlier.
entries.zh: 如果飞盘回到持盘队员手中，所有队员必须回到持盘队员传盘时或示意时他们所在的位置，以先发生者为准。

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: if the result of the play stands all players must return to the location they held when either a player established possession, or the disc hit the ground.
entries.zh: 如果传盘结果有效，所有队员必须返回接盘队员建立盘权或飞盘落地时他们所处的位置。

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: if a player other than the thrower gains possession as a result of an accepted breach, all players must return to the location they held when the breach occurred.
entries.zh: 如果由于无争议的违反规则，持盘队员以外的队员获得了盘权，所有队员必须回到违反规则发生时他们所处的位置。

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: All players must remain stationary in that location until the disc is checked in.
entries.zh: 在验盘前，所有队员必须在原位置保持静止不动。

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: Any player may briefly extend a stoppage of play to fix faulty equipment (“equipment”), but active play may not be stopped for this purpose.
entries.zh: 队员可在短暂地延长中断时间以修复故障的装备（同时示意“装备故障”），但不能以此为由停止进行中的比赛。

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: Prior to the check the person checking the disc in, and the nearest opposition player, must verify that their own team-mates are ready, and positioned as per 10.2.
entries.zh: 在验盘之前，验盘队员和最近的对方队员必须确认己方队员准备完毕，并且根据10.2 规定站位。

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: If there is an unnecessary delay in checking the disc in, the opposition may give a warning (“Delay of Game”). If the delay continues, the team that gave the warning may check the disc in by calling “Disc In”, without verification from the opposition, but only if the team checking the disc in are all stationary, and positioned as per 10.2.
entries.zh: 如果验盘有不必要的拖延，对手可以给予警告（“拖延比赛”）。如果拖延继续，给予警告的队伍可以通过喊“比赛开始”来进行验盘，而不需要对手确认，但前提是验盘方所有队员都保持静止，并且根据 10.2 规定站位。

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: To restart play with a check:
entries.zh: 通过验盘重新开始比赛：

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: when the thrower has the disc:
entries.zh: 当持盘队员手持飞盘时：

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: if there is a defender within reach, the defender must touch the disc.
entries.zh: 如果有防守队员在可触盘范围内，防守队员必须触碰飞盘。

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: if there is not a defender within reach, the thrower must touch the disc to the ground and may call “Disc In”.
entries.zh: 如果没有防守队员在可触盘范围内，持盘队员必须用盘触及地面并示意 “比赛开始”。

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: when the disc is on the ground, the defender nearest to the disc must call “Disc In”.
entries.zh: 当飞盘在地面时，离飞盘最近的防守队员必须示意“开始比赛”。

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: A player may call a violation regarding the check if an opponent:
entries.zh: 当对方出现以下情况时，队员可以示意验盘违例：

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: attempts a pass without an appropriate check as per 10.6; or
entries.zh: 没有按 10.6 要求进行验盘的情况下尝试传盘；

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: restarts play without verification from their nearest opposition player; or
entries.zh: 没有经过最近防守队员确认的情况下重新开始比赛；

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: is moving immediately prior to the check; or
entries.zh: 在验盘前移动；或

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: was not in the appropriate position.
entries.zh: 未处于正确的位置。

entries.title: 验盘
entries.en: After this violation call any pass does not count regardless of whether it is complete or incomplete, and possession reverts back to the thrower (unless 16.3 applies).
entries.zh: 在此违例示意后的任何传盘无效，无论传盘是否完成，盘权回到持盘队员手中 （除非 16.3 适用）。

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: The entire playing field is in-bounds. The perimeter lines are not part of the playing field and are out-of-bounds. All non-players are part of the out-of-bounds area.
entries.zh: 整个比赛场地为界内区域，边界线不属于比赛场地的一部分，属于界外。所有非场上队员都属于界外区域的部分。

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: The out-of-bounds area consists of the ground which is not in-bounds and everything in contact with it, except for defensive players, who are always considered “in-bounds”.
entries.zh: 界外包括不在界内的地面及与之接触的所有物体，但防守队员除外，他们始终被视为 “界内”状态。

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: An offensive player who is not out-of-bounds is in-bounds.
entries.zh: 不在界外的进攻队员属于界内。

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: An airborne player retains their in-bounds/out-of-bounds status until that player contacts the playing field or the out-of-bounds area.
entries.zh: 在空中的队员在未接触比赛场地或界外区域之前，将保持他们离地前的界内/界外的状态。

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: A player who has caught the disc, who contacts the playing field and then contacts an out-of-bounds area, is still considered in-bounds, as long as they maintain the catch until they establish possession.
entries.zh: 接盘队员在接盘后先接触比赛场地，随后接触界外区域，这一过程始终保持对飞盘的控制直到建立盘权，仍被视为界内。

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: If they leave the playing field, they must establish a pivot point at the location on the playing field where they crossed the perimeter line (unless 14.3 is in effect).
entries.zh: 如果该队员离开比赛场地，则必须在其穿越边界线时所在的比赛场地位置建立轴心点（除非 14.3 适用）。

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: A thrower who contacts an out-of-bounds area is considered in-bounds until they make a pass.
entries.zh: 接触到界外区域的持盘队员，在飞盘传出前被认为是界内状态。

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: Contact between players does not confer the state of being in- or out-of-bounds from one to another.
entries.zh: 队员间的接触不会将界内或界外的状态从某位队员传递给其他队员。

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: The following are out-of-bounds turnovers, and no catch is deemed to have occurred:
entries.zh: 以下情况属于因出界而发生的攻防转换，不被视为成功接盘：

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: any part of an offensive receiver is out-of-bounds when they contact the disc; or
entries.zh: 进攻方队员接触飞盘时任何部分与界外有接触；

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: after catching the disc while airborne, an offensive receiver’s first contact is out-of-bounds while still in contact with the disc.
entries.zh: 进攻队员在空中接盘后，第一接触点在界外，同时仍然与飞盘保持接触状态。

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: A disc is in-bounds once play is live, or when play starts or restarts.
entries.zh: 比赛处于“活盘”状态或比赛开始及重新开始时，飞盘属于界内。

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: A disc becomes out-of-bounds when it first contacts the out-of-bounds area or contacts an out-of-bounds offensive player. A disc that has been caught by an offensive player has the same in/out-of-bounds status as that player. If the disc is simultaneously caught by more than one offensive player, one of them being out-of-bounds, the disc is out-of-bounds.
entries.zh: 当飞盘接触到界外区域或接触界外的进攻队员时即为出界。进攻队员接住的飞盘与该队员的界内/界外状态一致。如果飞盘同时被多名进攻队员接住，其中一名队员在界外，则飞盘为出界。

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: The disc may fly outside a perimeter line and return to the playing field, and players may go out-of-bounds to make a play on the disc.
entries.zh: 飞盘可能会飞出边界线后飞回比赛场地，队员也可以在界外尝试触盘。

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: The place where a disc went out-of-bounds is the location where, prior to contacting an out-of-bounds area or player, the disc was most recently:
entries.zh: 飞盘出界的地点是飞盘接触界外区域或界外队员之前，飞盘最后一次：

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: partly or wholly over the playing field; or
entries.zh: 部分或完全在比赛场地上方；或

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: contacted by an in-bounds player.
entries.zh: 被界内队员接触的位置。

entries.title: 出界
entries.en: If the disc is out-of-bounds and more than three (3) metres from the pivot location, non-players may retrieve the disc. The thrower must carry the disc the last three (3) metres to the playing field.
entries.zh: 如果飞盘出界并且距离轴心点超过 3 米，非场上队员可以取回飞盘。最后3米必须由持盘队员带回比赛场地。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: A “catch” occurs when a player has a non-spinning disc trapped between at least two body parts. A catch can enable a player to establish possession of the disc.
entries.zh: “接盘”指的是队员通过至少两个身体部位夹住一个停止旋转的飞盘。接盘意味着队员建立盘权。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: If the player fails to maintain the catch due to subsequent ground contact related to the catch, or contact related to the catch with a team-mate or a legitimately positioned opposition player, possession is deemed to have not occurred.
entries.zh: 如果队员接盘后，因随后与地面的接触，或因接盘与队友、与合法位置上的防守队员发生接触而未能控制飞盘，则视为未建立盘权。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: After establishing possession, that player becomes the thrower.
entries.zh: 建立盘权后，该队员成为持盘队员。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: If offensive and defensive players catch the disc simultaneously, the offence retains possession.
entries.zh: 如果进攻和防守队员同时接到飞盘，则进攻方拥有盘权。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: A player in an established position is entitled to remain in that position and must not be contacted by an opposing player.
entries.zh: 已占据某位置的队员有权保持在该位置，并且对方队员不得对其有身体接触。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: Every player is entitled to occupy any position on the field not occupied by any opposing player, provided that they do not initiate contact in taking such a position, and are not moving in a reckless or dangerously aggressive manner.
entries.zh: 每位队员有权占据场上任何未被对方队员占据的位置，前提是他们在占据该位置时未主动接触到对方队员，并且不以鲁莽或危险的攻击性的方式移动。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: However when the disc is in the air a player may not move in a manner solely to prevent an opponent from taking an unoccupied path to make a play on the disc.
entries.zh: 但是，当飞盘在空中时，队员的移动不能仅仅是为了阻碍尝试触盘的对方队员，前往未被占据的路径。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: All players must attempt to avoid initiating contact with other players, and there is no situation where a player may justify initiating contact. This includes avoiding initiating contact with a stationary opponent, or an opponent’s expected position based on their established speed and direction.
entries.zh: 所有队员应当尽力避免主动接触其他队员，无论何时，队员都没有任何理由主动发起接触。包括避免主动接触处于静止状态的对方队员，或避免与按照既定的速度和方向到达预期位置的对方队员发生接触。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: “Making a play for the disc” is not a valid excuse for initiating contact with other players.
entries.zh: “冲着接盘去”不是主动接触其他队员的正当理由。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: Before a player dives, leaps or jumps away from their position, they must be reasonably certain they will not initiate contact with an opponent.
entries.zh: 在队员飞扑、跳跃或起跳离开原位置之前，他们必须充分确信不会与对方队员发生身体接触。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: If a player is not reasonably certain that they will be able to make a legal play at the disc before an opponent who is moving in a legal manner, they must adjust their movements to avoid initiating contact. If that adjustment is made, the result of the play still stands.
entries.zh: 当对方队员合规地向飞盘移动时，如果队员无法充分确信自己能以合规的方式先接触飞盘，则该队员必须调整自身动作，以避免发生身体接触。如果做出调整，比赛结果仍有效。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: The player who initiates contact is deemed to be the player who:
entries.zh: 有以下行为的队员视为发起接触的队员：

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: arrived at the point of contact after the opponent had already established a legitimate position at that point (either a stationary or moving opponent), or
entries.zh: 在对方队员已建立合法位置（无论其为静止抑或移动状态）后抵达该处并发生接触；或者

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: adjusted their movements in a way that created unavoidable contact with an opponent moving in a legal manner, when taking into account all players’ established position, speed and direction.
entries.zh: 在考虑到所有队员已占据的位置、移动速度和方向后调整自己的动作，造成与合规移动中的对方队员发生不可避免的身体接触。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: If it is unclear which player initiated contact, and one of the players dived, leaped or jumped away from their position, that player is deemed to have initiated contact.
entries.zh: 如果无法确定哪名队员主动发起接触，那么飞扑、跳跃或起跳离开原位置的这名队员将视为发起接触的队员。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: Some minor contact may occur as two or more players move towards a single point simultaneously. Minor contact should be minimized but is not considered a foul.
entries.zh: 当两名或更多的队员同时向一个位置移动时，可能会发生轻微的接触。轻微接触应尽量减少，但不视为犯规。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: Players may not use their extended arms or legs to obstruct the movement of opposing players.
entries.zh: 队员不得伸出手臂或腿阻碍对方队员移动。

entries.title: 接盘队员与位置
entries.en: No player may physically assist the movement of another player, nor use an item of equipment or object to assist in contacting the disc.
entries.zh: 队员不能用身体协助其他队员移动，也不能借助装备或物品接触飞盘。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: A turnover that transfers possession of the disc from one team to the other occurs when:
entries.zh: 当发生以下情况时，盘权从一个队伍转移到另一个队伍：

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: the disc contacts the ground while it is not in the possession of an offensive player (a “down”);
entries.zh: 飞盘在没有被进攻队员控制的情况下接触地面（“飞盘触地”）；

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: however it is not “down” if a receiver catches a pass before the disc contacts the ground, and maintains the catch while the disc is in contact with the ground.
entries.zh: 但是，如果接盘队员在飞盘接触地面前接住了传盘，并在飞盘接触地面时保持对飞盘的控制，则不是“飞盘触地”。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: a defensive player establishes possession of a pass (an “interception”);
entries.zh: 防守队员接住了传盘（“截获”）；

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: the disc becomes out-of-bounds (an “out-of-bounds” or “out”); or
entries.zh: 飞盘出界；

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: during the pull, the offence touches the disc before it hits the ground, and subsequently fails to establish possession of the disc (a “dropped pull”).
entries.zh: 在开盘时，进攻方在飞盘落地前接触飞盘，随后未能建立盘权（“接开盘掉盘”）。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: A turnover that transfers possession of the disc from one team to the other, and results in a stoppage of play, occurs when:
entries.zh: 当发生以下情况时，盘权从一个队伍转移到另一个队伍，并导致比赛中断：

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: there is an accepted offensive receiving foul;
entries.zh: 无争议的进攻接盘犯规；

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: the thrower has not released the pass before the marker first starts to say the word “ten” in the stall count (a “stall-out”);
entries.zh: 防盘队员读秒到“ 10”前，持盘队员未传出飞盘（“读秒超时”）；

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: the disc is intentionally transferred from one offensive player to another without ever being completely untouched by both players (a “handover”);
entries.zh: 持盘队员故意将盘传递给另一个进攻队员，该过程存在两人同时对盘的接触（“递盘”）；

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: the thrower intentionally deflects a pass to themselves off another player (a “deflection”);
entries.zh: 持盘队员故意将飞盘传向其他队员，使飞盘回弹给自己（“回弹”）；

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: in attempting a pass, the thrower catches the disc after release prior to the disc being contacted by another player (a “self-catch”);
entries.zh: 持盘队员传盘后，在其他队员接触飞盘前接住了飞盘（“自传自接”）；

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: an offensive player intentionally assists a team-mate’s movement to catch a pass; or
entries.zh: 进攻队员故意协助队友移动去接盘；或

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: an offensive player uses an item of equipment or object to assist in catching a pass.
entries.zh: 进攻队员非法使用装备或物品协助接住传盘。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: If a player determines a turnover has occurred they must make the appropriate call immediately. If the opposition disagrees they may call “contest” and play must stop. If, after discussion, players cannot agree or it is unclear what occurred in the play, the disc must be returned to the last non-disputed thrower.
entries.zh: 如果队员确定发生了攻防转换，他们必须立即做出相应的示意。如果对方不同意，他们可以示意“有争议”，比赛必须停止。如果双方队员讨论后无法达成一致，或者不清楚发生了什么，飞盘必须回到最后一个无争议的持盘队员手中。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: After a “stall-out” call:
entries.zh: 在“读秒超时”示意后：

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: If the thrower still has possession of the disc, but they believe a fast count occurred in such a manner that they did not have a reasonable opportunity to call fast count before a stall-out, the play is treated as either an accepted defensive breach (9.5.1) or a contested stall-out (9.5.3).
entries.zh: 如果持盘队员认为由于读秒过快导致飞盘未传出，并且也没有机会在“读秒超时”前做出读秒过快的示意，应按照无争议的防守违规（9.5.1）或有争议的读秒超时（9.5.3） 处理。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: If the thrower made a completed pass, the thrower can contest if they believe it was not a “stall-out”, or there was a fast count immediately prior to the “stall-out”.
entries.zh: 如果持盘队员传盘成功，持盘队员可以就“读秒超时 ”提出异议，或者认为在读秒超时前有读秒过快的违规。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: If the thrower contests a stall-out but also attempts a pass, and the pass is incomplete, then the turnover stands and play restarts with a check.
entries.zh: 如果持盘队员对读秒超时的示意提出争议，但仍尝试传盘，且该传盘不成功，则攻防转换成立，验盘后比赛重新开始。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: Any offensive player may establish possession of the disc after a turnover, except:
entries.zh: 在攻防转换后，任何进攻队员都可以建立盘权，除非：

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: after an “interception” turnover, in which case the player who made the interception must maintain possession; and
entries.zh: 在“截获”造成攻防转换后，截获飞盘的队员必须保持盘权；

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: after an accepted receiving foul caused by the offence, in which case the fouled player must establish possession.
entries.zh: 在无争议的进攻方接盘犯规后，被犯规的队员必须建立盘权。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: If the player in possession after a turnover, or after a pull that has already hit the ground, intentionally drops the disc, places the disc on the ground, or transfers possession of the disc, they must re-establish possession and restart play with a check.
entries.zh: 在攻防转换，或者在开盘已接触地面后，持盘队员故意丢掉飞盘、将飞盘放在地面上，或者将飞盘的盘权交给其他队员，则该队员必须重新建立盘权并通过验盘重新开始比赛。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: After a turnover, the turnover location is where:
entries.zh: 攻防转换发生的位置是：

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: the disc has come to a stop or is picked up by an offensive player; or
entries.zh: 飞盘停下或进攻队员捡起飞盘的位置；

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: the intercepting player stops; or
entries.zh: 截获飞盘的队员停下的位置；

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: the thrower was located at the time of the call, in the case of 13.2.2, 13.2.3, 13.2.4, 13.2.5; or

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: the offensive player was located, in the case of 13.2.6 and 13.2.7; or
entries.zh: 在 13.2.6 和 13.2.7 发生时，违规进攻队员所在的位置；

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: the accepted offensive receiving foul occurred.
entries.zh: 无争议的进攻接盘犯规发生的位置。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: If the turnover location is out-of-bounds, or the disc touched an out-of-bounds area after the turnover occurred, the thrower must establish a pivot point at the location on the central zone nearest to where the disc went out-of-bounds (Section 11.8).
entries.zh: 如果攻防转换位置在界外，或者攻防转换发生后飞盘接触了界外区域，持盘队员必须在离飞盘出界点最近的中心区位置建立轴心点（第 11.8 条）。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: If 13.8 does not apply, a pivot point must be established according to 13.9, 13.10, or 13.11.
entries.zh: 如果 13.8 不适用，则应根据 13.9、 13.10 或 13.11 建立轴心点。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: If the turnover location is in the central zone, the thrower must establish a pivot point at that location.
entries.zh: 如果攻防转换在中心区，持盘队员必须在该位置建立轴心点。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: If the turnover location is in the offence’s attacking end zone, the thrower must establish a pivot point at the nearest location on the goal line.
entries.zh: 如果攻防转换发生在进攻方的进攻得分区，持盘队员必须在离攻防转换位置最近的得分线上建立轴心点。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: If the turnover location is in the offence’s defending end zone, the thrower may choose where to establish a pivot point:
entries.zh: 如果攻防转换在进攻方的防守得分区，持盘队员可以选择以下位置建立轴心点：

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: at the turnover location, by staying at the turnover location or faking a pass; or
entries.zh: 在攻防转换发生的位置，通过停留在该位置或做出传盘假动作表明选择；

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: at the nearest location on the goal line to the turnover location, by moving from the turnover location.
entries.zh: 在离攻防转换位置最近的得分线位置，通过移动到该位置来表明选择。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: The intended thrower, before picking up the disc, may signal the goal line option by fully extending one arm above their head.
entries.zh: 持盘队员在捡起飞盘之前，可以通过将一只手臂完全伸展到头顶上方来示意选择在得分线传盘。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: Immediate movement, staying at the turnover location, faking a pass, or signaling the goal line option, determines where to establish a pivot point and cannot be reversed.
entries.zh: 立即移动、停留在攻防转换位置、做传盘假动作或示意到得分线的位置，即确定了建立轴心点的位置，且不可撤销。

entries.title: 攻防转换
entries.en: If, after an accepted turnover, play has continued unknowingly, play stops and the disc is returned to the turnover location, players resume their positions at the time the turnover occurred and play restarts with a check.
entries.zh: 如果在无争议的攻防转换后，比赛因不知情的队员继续进行，那么比赛需要停止，飞盘回到攻防转换发生的位置，队员回到攻防转换发生时的位置，并通过验盘重新开始比赛。

entries.title: 得分
entries.en: A goal is scored if an in-bounds player catches a legal pass and:
entries.zh: 得分是一名界内队员接住合规的传盘，并且：

entries.title: 得分
entries.en: all their ground contacts are entirely within their attacking end zone, or for an airborne player, all of their first simultaneous points of ground contact after catching the disc are entirely within their attacking end zone, and
entries.zh: 该队员与地面的接触完全在进攻的得分区内，或在空中接盘的队员首次触地点完全在进攻的得分区内，并且

entries.title: 得分
entries.en: they subsequently establish possession of the disc, and maintain the catch throughout all ground contact related to the catch (note 12.1, 12.1.1).
entries.zh: 该队员随后建立了对盘的控制，并在因接盘而触地的全程中保持对飞盘的控制 （参见 12.1 ， 12.1.1）。

entries.title: 得分
entries.en: If a player believes a goal has been scored, they may call “goal” and play stops. After a contested or retracted goal call play must restart with a check and the call is deemed to have been made when the player established possession.
entries.zh: 如果队员认为已得分，可以示意“得分”，并停止比赛。在有争议或撤回得分示意后，比赛必须通过验盘重新开始，且该示意视为在队员建立盘权时已经做出。

entries.title: 得分
entries.en: If a player in possession of the disc ends up in the end zone they are attacking without scoring a goal according to 14.1, the player must establish a pivot point at the nearest location on the goal line.
entries.zh: 如果一名拥有盘权的队员进入了进攻得分区，但不符合 14.1 描述的得分，则该队员必须在距离他最近的得分线上建立轴心点。

entries.title: 得分
entries.en: The time at which a goal is deemed to have been scored is when the player established possession.
entries.zh: 得分被视为在队员建立盘权的时发生。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: A breach of the rules due to non-minor contact between two or more opposing players is a foul.
entries.zh: 因为两名或多名双方队员之间发生非轻微接触而违反规则的行为被称为犯规。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: A player intentionally initiating minor contact is still a breach of the rules, but is to be treated as a violation, and not a foul.
entries.zh: 队员故意发起轻微接触仍然是违反规则，但应被视为违例，而非犯规。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: A breach of the rules regarding a Marking or Travel breach is an infraction. Infractions do not stop play.
entries.zh: 涉及防盘或走步的违反规则的行为是违规。违规不会停止比赛。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: Every other breach of the rules is a violation.
entries.zh: 其他所有违反规则的行为都是违例。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: Only the player fouled may claim a foul, by calling “Foul”.
entries.zh: 只有被犯规的队员可以通过示意“犯规”来声明违规。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: In general only the thrower may claim an infraction, by calling the specific name of the infraction.
entries.zh: 通常只有持盘队员可以示意违规的具体名称。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: However any offensive player may call a double team, and any defensive player may call a travel infraction.
entries.zh: 但是，任何进攻队员都可以示意“双人防守”，任何防守队员都可以示意“走步”。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: Any opposing player may claim a violation, by calling the specific name of the violation or “Violation”, unless specified otherwise by the particular rule.
entries.zh: 任何对方队员都可以通过示意违例的具体名称或“违例 ”来声明违例，除非特定规则另有规定。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: When a foul or violation call is made that stops play, players must stop play by visibly or audibly communicating the stoppage as soon as they are aware of the call and all players should echo calls on the field. If play has stopped for a discussion without any call having been made, a call is deemed to have been made when the discussion started.
entries.zh: 当犯规或违例示意停止比赛时，队员必须在意识到示意后，通过手势或声音传达停止比赛，所有队员应在场上回应示意内容。如果比赛因讨论而停止，而没有做出任何示意，那么视为示意在讨论开始时已经做出。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: Calls must be made immediately after the breach is recognised.
entries.zh: 在识别到违反规则的行为后，必须立即做出示意。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: After a player initiates a stoppage incorrectly, including after mishearing a call, not knowing the rules, or not making the call immediately:
entries.zh: 在队员错误地中断了比赛后，包括听错示意、不懂规则或没有立刻做出示意：

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: if the opposition gains or retains possession, any subsequent play stands.
entries.zh: 如果对方获得或保留盘权，则随后的比赛结果保留。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: if the opposition does not gain or retain possession, the disc must be returned to the last non-disputed thrower, unless 16.3 applies.
entries.zh: 如果对方未能获得或保留盘权，则飞盘必须回到最后一个无争议持盘队员手中，除非 16.3 适用。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: The stall count resumes as if an accepted breach has been caused by the player who initiated the stoppage incorrectly.
entries.zh: 读秒按照错误中断比赛的队员造成了无争议的违反规则行为来恢复。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: If the player against whom the foul, infraction or violation has been called disagrees that it occurred, or does not think it is a correct call, they may call “Contest”.
entries.zh: 如果被示意犯规、违例或违规的队员不同意发生该行为，或认为示意不正确，可以示意“有争议”。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: If a player making any call subsequently determines that their call was incorrect, they can retract the call, by calling “Retracted“. Play resumes as if an accepted breach has been caused by that player.
entries.zh: 如果做出示意的队员随后确认示意有误，可以通过示意“撤回”取消之前的示意。比赛将按照该队员造成无争议的违反规则的行为恢复。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: If multiple breaches occur on the same play or before play stops, the outcomes should be resolved in reverse sequence (latest breach first, earliest breach last).
entries.zh: 如果在同一回合或比赛停止前发生了多个违反规则的行为，比赛结果应按逆序处理 （先解决最后一个示意，最后解决最早的示意）。

entries.title: 示意犯规、违规及违例
entries.en: Players are encouraged to use the WFDF Hand Signals to communicate all calls.
entries.zh: 鼓励队员使用世界飞盘联合会手势来传达所有示意。

entries.title: 示意后的继续比赛
entries.en: Whenever a foul or violation call is made, or a player attempts to stop play in any way, play stops immediately and no turnover is possible (unless in situations specified in 15.9, 16.2, and 16.3).
entries.zh: 每当发生犯规或违规示意，或队员以任何方式试图停止比赛时，比赛应立即停止，且不会产生攻防转换（除非在 15.9、 16.2 和 16.3 中有具体规定的情形）。

entries.title: 示意后的继续比赛
entries.en: If a foul or violation: then play continues until possession has been established.
entries.zh: 如果犯规或违例：

entries.title: 示意后的继续比赛
entries.en: is called against the thrower and the thrower attempts a pass, or
entries.zh: 是对持盘队员的示意，且持盘队员尝试传盘，或者

entries.title: 示意后的继续比赛
entries.en: is called by the thrower during the act of throwing, or
entries.zh: 由持盘队员在传盘动作中发出的示意，或者

entries.title: 示意后的继续比赛
entries.en: is called or occurs when the disc is in the air,
entries.zh: 是飞盘在空中时发出的示意或发生的情况，则比赛继续直到建立盘权。

entries.title: 示意后的继续比赛
entries.en: Once possession has been established:
entries.zh: 一旦建立盘权：

entries.title: 示意后的继续比赛
entries.en: If the team that called the foul or violation gains or retains possession as a result of the pass, the play stands. Play can continue without a stoppage if the player who made the foul or violation call makes a “Play on” call as soon as possible.
entries.zh: 如果示意犯规或违例的队伍在传盘后获得或保持盘权，比赛结果保留。如果示意犯规或违例的队员尽快立刻示意“继续比赛”，则比赛可在不中断的情况下继续进行。

entries.title: 示意后的继续比赛
entries.en: If the team that called the foul or violation does not gain or retain possession as a result of the pass, play must be stopped.
entries.zh: 如果示意犯规或违例的队伍在传盘后没有获得或保持盘权，则比赛必须停止。

entries.title: 示意后的继续比赛
entries.en: If the team that called the foul or violation believes that possession has been affected by the foul or violation, the disc will be returned to the thrower for a check (unless the specific rule says otherwise).
entries.zh: 如果示意犯规或违例的队伍认为盘权受到犯规或违例的影响，飞盘将回到持盘队员手中并验盘（除非具体规则另有规定）。

entries.title: 示意后的继续比赛
entries.en: Regardless of when any call is made, if the players involved from both teams agree that the event or call did not affect the outcome, the play stands. This rule is not superseded by any other rule.
entries.zh: 无论何时发出任何示意，如果双方相关队员都同意该事件或示意未影响比赛结果，则比赛结果保留。本条规则不被其他任何规则取代。

entries.title: 示意后的继续比赛
entries.en: If the play resulted in a goal, the goal stands.
entries.zh: 如果比赛结果是得分，则得分有效。

entries.title: 示意后的继续比赛
entries.en: If the play did not result in a goal the affected players may make up any positional disadvantage caused by the event or call and restart play with a check.
entries.zh: 如果比赛结果不是得分，受到影响的队员可以弥补由事件或示意造成的位置劣势，并通过验盘重新开始比赛。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: Dangerous Play:
entries.zh: 危险动作：

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: Actions demonstrating reckless disregard for the safety of fellow players, or posing significant risk of injury to fellow players, or other dangerously aggressive behaviours, are considered dangerous play and must be treated as a foul, regardless of whether or when contact occurs. This rule is not superseded by any other foul rule. If the dangerous play call is accepted, this must be treated as the most relevant foul from Section 17.
entries.zh: 任何不顾其他队员安全的鲁莽行为，或对其他队员造成重大伤害风险的行为，或其他危险的攻击行为，均被视为危险动作，必须作为犯规处理，无论身体接触是否发生或何时发生。本条规则不被任何其他犯规规则取代。如果危险动作示意无争议，必须按照第 17章中最相关的犯规处理。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: Receiving Fouls:
entries.zh: 接盘犯规：

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: A Receiving Foul occurs when a player initiates non-minor contact with an opponent before, while, or directly after, either player makes a play on the disc.
entries.zh: 接盘犯规是双方队员在尝试触盘之前、期间或之后，一方向对手发起了非轻微接触。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: Contact with an opponent’s arms or hands, that occurs after the disc has been caught, or after the opponent can no longer make a play on the disc, is not a sufficient basis for a foul, but should be avoided (excluding contact related to Section 17.1 and 17.3).
entries.zh: 在飞盘被接住或对手无法尝试触盘时，与对手的手臂或手发生接触不足以构成犯规，但应尽量避免（不包括与 17.1 和 17.3 相关的接触）。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: After an accepted receiving foul the fouled player gains possession at the location of the breach, even if that location is in an end zone, and play restarts with a check. If, after the check, 14.3 applies, the stall count can not be started until a pivot point is established at the nearest location on the goal line. If the foul is contested, the disc is returned to the thrower.
entries.zh: 如果接盘犯规无争议，被犯规队员将在犯规发生的位置获得盘权，即使该位置在得分区内，并且需通过验盘重新开始比赛。如果在验盘后适用规则 14.3 ，队员在回到最近的得分线上位置建立轴心点后，才可以开始读秒。如果犯规有争议，飞盘将回到持盘队员手中。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: Strip Fouls:
entries.zh: 夺权犯规：

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: A Strip Foul occurs when an opponent fouls a player and that causes the player to drop a disc they caught or to lose possession of the disc.
entries.zh: 夺权犯规是指因为对手对接盘队员的犯规，导致队员掉落已接住的飞盘或失去盘权。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: If the reception would have otherwise been a goal, and the foul is accepted, a goal is awarded.
entries.zh: 如果接盘原本可以得分，且犯规无争议，则视为得分。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: Blocking Fouls:
entries.zh: 阻拦犯规：

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: A Blocking Foul occurs when a player takes a position that an opponent moving in a legal manner will be unable to avoid, taking into account the opponents expected position based on their established speed and direction, and non-minor contact results. This is to be treated as either a receiving foul or an indirect foul, whichever is applicable.
entries.zh: 阻拦犯规是指一名队员在考虑到对手基于其既定速度和方向所能达到的预期位置之后，仍占据了一个对手以合规方式移动无法避开的位置，并且造成了非轻微接触。这种情况应视为接盘犯规或间接犯规，具体视情况而定。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: Force-out Fouls:
entries.zh: 被迫出界犯规：

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: A Force-out Foul occurs when a receiver is in the process of establishing possession of the disc, and is fouled by a defensive player before subsequently establishing possession, and the contact caused the receiver:
entries.zh: 当接盘队员在建立盘权的过程中，且在建立盘权前遭防守队员犯规时，且该接触导致接盘队员：

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: to catch the disc out-of-bounds instead of in-bounds; or
entries.zh: 在界外而不是在界内接到飞盘；或

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: to catch the disc in the central zone instead of their attacking end zone.
entries.zh: 在中心区接盘，而不是其进攻得分区接到飞盘。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: If the receiver would have caught the disc in their attacking end zone, it is a goal;
entries.zh: 如果接盘队员原本可以在进攻得分区接到飞盘，则视为得分。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: If the force-out foul is contested, the disc is returned to the thrower if the receiver became out-of-bounds, otherwise the disc stays with the receiver.
entries.zh: 在被迫出界犯规有争议时，如果接盘队员出界，飞盘应回到持盘队员手中，如果接盘队员没有出界，飞盘将保留在接盘队员手中。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: Defensive Throwing (Marking) Fouls:
entries.zh: 防盘犯规：

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: A Defensive Throwing Foul occurs when:
entries.zh: 防盘犯规发生在以下情况：

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: There is non-minor contact between the thrower and an illegally positioned defensive player (Section 18.1); or
entries.zh: 持盘队员与违规站位的防守队员发生非轻微接触（见规则 18.1 条）；或

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: A defensive player initiates non-minor contact with the thrower, or there is non-minor contact resulting from the thrower and the defender both vying for the same unoccupied position, prior to the thrower releasing the pass.
entries.zh: 持盘队员传出飞盘前，防守队员主动与持盘队员发生非轻微接触，或持盘队员与防守队员同时争夺一个空位时发生非轻微接触。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: If a Defensive Throwing Foul occurs prior to the thrower releasing the pass and not during the throwing motion, the thrower may choose to call a contact infraction, by calling “Contact”. After a contact infraction that is not contested, play does not stop and the marker must resume the stall count at one (1).
entries.zh: 如果防盘犯规发生在持盘队员传盘前而非传盘动作中，持盘队员可示意 “身体接触”。如果接触违规无争议，比赛不停止，防盘队员必须从 1 恢复读秒。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: Offensive Throwing (Thrower) Fouls:
entries.zh: 进攻传盘（持盘队员）犯规：

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: An Offensive Throwing Foul occurs when the thrower is solely responsible for initiating non-minor contact with a defensive player who is in a legal position.
entries.zh: 进攻传盘犯规是持盘队员对处于合法位置的防守队员造成的非轻微接触。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: Contact occurring during the thrower's follow through is not a sufficient basis for a foul, but should be avoided.
entries.zh: 由持盘队员传盘后的惯性动作造成的接触不足以构成犯规，但应尽量避免。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: Indirect Fouls:
entries.zh: 间接犯规：

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: An Indirect Foul occurs when there is non-minor contact between a receiver and a defensive player that does not directly affect an attempt to make a play on the disc.
entries.zh: 间接犯规是接盘队员与防守队员之间发生了非轻微接触，但不直接影响尝试触盘。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: Prior to making the “Indirect Foul” call, the player may delay the call up to two (2) seconds to determine if the breach will affect the play.
entries.zh: 在示意“ 间接犯规”前，队员最多可延迟 2 秒示意，以决定该违反规则的行为是否会影响比赛。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: If the foul is accepted the fouled player may make up any positional disadvantage caused by the foul.
entries.zh: 如果间接犯规无争议，被犯规队员可弥补因犯规造成的位置劣势。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: Offsetting Fouls:
entries.zh: 抵消犯规：

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: If accepted fouls are called by offensive and defensive players on the same play, these are offsetting fouls, and the disc must be returned to the last non-disputed thrower.
entries.zh: 抵消犯规是指进攻和防守队员同时示意了犯规，且均无争议。飞盘必须回到上一个无争议的持盘队员手中。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: If there is non-minor contact that is caused by two or more opposing players moving towards a single point simultaneously, this must be treated as offsetting fouls.
entries.zh: 如果两名或更多双方队员同时向同一位置移动时，造成了非轻微接触，则视为抵消犯规。

entries.title: 犯规
entries.en: However if this occurs after the disc has been caught, or after the relevant player/s involved can no longer make a play on the disc, this must be treated as an Indirect Foul (excluding contact related to Section 17.1).
entries.zh: 但如果该接触发生在飞盘被接住之后，或相关队员已无法尝试触盘，则此类情况应视为间接犯规（不包括第 17.1 条所述的接触）。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: Marking Infractions:
entries.zh: 防盘违规：

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: Marking infractions include the following:
entries.zh: 防盘违规包括以下情况：

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: “Fast Count” – the marker:
entries.zh: “读秒过快”——指防盘队员：

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: starts or continues the stall count illegally,
entries.zh: 违规开始或继续读秒；

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: does not start or restart the stall count with “Stalling”,
entries.zh: 没有以“开始（读秒）”开始或重新开始读秒；

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: counts in less than one second intervals,
entries.zh: 读秒间隔不足 1 秒；

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: does not correctly reduce or reset the stall count when required, or
entries.zh: 在需要时没有正确减少读秒或重新开始读秒；或

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: does not start the stall count from the correct number.
entries.zh: 没有从正确的数字开始读秒。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: “Straddle” – a line between a defensive player’s feet comes within one disc diameter of the thrower’s pivot point.
entries.zh: “跨越”是防盘队员的双脚之间的连线与持盘队员的轴心点不足一个飞盘距离。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: “Disc Space” – any part of a defensive player is less than one disc diameter away from the torso of the thrower. However, if this situation is caused solely by movement of the thrower, it is not an infraction.
entries.zh: “间距过小”是防盘队员身体的任何部位与持盘队员的躯干不足一个飞盘距离。但是，如果该情况是由于持盘队员的移动引起，则不视为违规。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: “Wrapping” – a line between a defensive player’s hands or arms comes within one disc diameter of the thrower’s torso, or any part of the defensive player’s body is above the thrower’s pivot point. However, if this situation is caused solely by movement of the thrower, it is not an infraction.
entries.zh: “包夹”是防盘队员的双手或手臂之间的连线与持盘队员躯干不足一个飞盘距离，或防盘队员身体的任何部位在持盘队员轴心点上方。但是，如果该情况是由于持盘队员的移动引起，则不视为违规。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: “Double Team” – a defensive player other than the marker is within three (3) metres of the thrower's pivot point without also guarding another offensive player.
entries.zh: “双人防守”是除防盘队员外的防守队员距离持盘队员轴心点不足 3 米，且该队员没有防守其他进攻队员。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: The defender guarding another offensive player can attempt to prevent a pass from the thrower, as long as they continue to guard another offensive player.
entries.zh: 只要防守队员仍然保持着对另一名进攻队员的防守，他可以尝试阻止持盘队员传盘。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: Merely running across this area is not a double team.
entries.zh: 仅仅穿过该区域不是双人防守。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: “Vision” - a defensive player uses any part of their body to intentionally obstruct the thrower’s vision.
entries.zh: “阻挡视线”是防守队员利用身体的任何部位故意遮挡持盘队员的视线。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: A marking infraction may be contested by the defence, in which case play stops.
entries.zh: 防守队员可以对防盘违规提出异议，此时比赛将停止。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: If a pass has been completed, a contested or retracted marking infraction must be treated as a violation by the offence, and the disc must be returned to the thrower.
entries.zh: 如果传盘已完成且被接住，则有争议或者撤回的防盘违规视为进攻违例，飞盘必须回到持盘队员手中。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: After all marking infractions listed in 18.1.1 and where play has not stopped, the marker must resume the stall count with the number last fully uttered before the call, minus one (1).
entries.zh: 在 18.1.1 中列出的所有防盘违规行为后，如果比赛没有停止，防盘队员必须在示意前完整读出的最后数字减去 1 后恢复读秒。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: The marker must not resume counting until any illegal positioning has been corrected. To do otherwise is a subsequent marking infraction.
entries.zh: 防盘队员必须在所有违规位置被纠正后才可以恢复读秒。否则构成连续防盘违规。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: Instead of calling a marking infraction, the relevant player may call a marking violation and stop play if;
entries.zh: 如有以下情况，相关队员可以示意防盘违例并停止比赛，而不是示意防盘违规：

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: the stall count is not corrected,
entries.zh: 读秒没有纠正；

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: there is no stall count,
entries.zh: 没有开始读秒；

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: there is an egregious marking infraction, or
entries.zh: 严重的防盘违规；或

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: there is a pattern of repeated marking infractions.
entries.zh: 存在反复发生的防盘违规行为。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: If a marking infraction, or a marking violation, is called and the thrower also attempts a pass before, during or after the call, the call has no consequences (unless 18.1.2.1 applies) and if the pass is incomplete, then the turnover stands.
entries.zh: 如果防盘违规或防盘违例被示意，且持盘队员在示意之前、期间或之后尝试传盘，则该示意不影响传盘结果（除非适用 18.1.2.1），如果传盘不成功，则为攻防转换。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: “Travel” Infractions:
entries.zh: “走步”违规

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: After catching the disc, the thrower must reduce speed as quickly as possible, without changing direction, until they have established a pivot point.
entries.zh: 在接住飞盘后，持盘队员必须在不改变方向的情况下尽快减速，直到建立轴心点。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: However if a player catches the disc while running or jumping the player may release a pass without attempting to reduce speed and without establishing a pivot point, provided that:
entries.zh: 然而，如果队员在跑动或跳跃时接到飞盘，他们可以在不尝试减速并且没有建立轴心点的情况下传盘，前提是：

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: they do not change direction or increase speed until they release the pass; and
entries.zh: 他们在传盘前没有改变方向或加速；

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: a maximum of two additional points of contact with the ground are made after the catch and before they release the pass.
entries.zh: 从接盘后到传盘前最多与地面接触两次。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: The thrower may move in any direction (pivot) only by establishing and maintaining a pivot point until releasing a pass.
entries.zh: 持盘队员在传出飞盘前，只能通过建立并维持轴心点的方式（轴转） 向任何方向移动。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: A thrower who is not standing can use any part of their body as the pivot point.
entries.zh: 如果持盘队员不是站立状态，可以用身体的任意部位作为轴心点。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: If they stand up it is not a travel, but only if a pivot point is established at the same location.
entries.zh: 如果该持盘队员站立起来不算走步，前提是轴心点保持在相同的位置。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: A travel infraction occurs if:
entries.zh: 如果发生以下情况，则构成走步违规：

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: the thrower establishes a pivot point at an incorrect location, including by not reducing speed as quickly as possible after a catch, or changing direction after a catch;
entries.zh: 持盘队员在错误的位置建立轴心点，包括接盘后没有尽快减速，或接盘后改变了方向；

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: the thrower releases a pass in breach of 18.2.1.1;
entries.zh: 持盘队员在违反 18.2.1.1 的情况下传盘；

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: anytime the thrower must move to a specified location, the thrower does not establish a pivot point before a wind-up or throwing motion begins;
entries.zh: 当持盘队员必须移动到指定位置，持盘队员在没有建立轴心点前做出了挥臂或掷盘动作；

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: the thrower fails to keep the established pivot point until releasing a pass;
entries.zh: 持盘队员在传盘前未能保持在已建立的轴心点；

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: a player intentionally bobbles, fumbles or delays the disc to themselves, for the sole purpose of moving in a specific direction.
entries.zh: 队员为了向特定方向移动而故意漏接、拍打飞盘或拖延控制飞盘的行为。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: After an accepted travel infraction is called (“travel”), play does not stop.
entries.zh: 在无争议的走步违规后，比赛不停止。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: The thrower establishes a pivot point at the correct location, as indicated by the player who called the travel. This must occur without delay from either player involved.
entries.zh: 持盘队员应在示意走步的队员所指示的正确位置立即建立轴心点。双方均不得拖延。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: Any stall count is paused, and the thrower may not throw the disc, until a pivot point is established at the correct location.
entries.zh: 在正确的位置建立轴心前，读秒需要暂停，且持盘队员不能传盘。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: The marker does not need to say “Stalling” before resuming the stall count.
entries.zh: 防盘队员不需要在恢复读秒之前说“读秒”。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: If, after a travel infraction but before correcting the pivot point, the thrower throws a completed pass, the defensive team may call a travel violation. Play stops and the disc is returned to the thrower. The thrower must return to the location occupied at the time of the infraction. Play must restart with a check.
entries.zh: 如果在发生走步违规后但在纠正轴心点之前，持盘队员传出飞盘并被接住，防守队伍可以示意走步违例。比赛停止，飞盘回到持盘队员手中。持盘队员必须回到违例时所在的位置。比赛通过验盘重新开始。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: If, after a travel infraction, the thrower throws an incomplete pass, play continues.
entries.zh: 如果在走步违规后，持盘队员传盘不成功，比赛继续进行。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: After a contested travel infraction where the thrower has not released a pass, play stops.
entries.zh: 若走步违规示意存在争议，且持盘队员未出盘，则比赛停止。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: “Pick” Violations:
entries.zh: “阻挡”违例

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: If a defensive player is guarding one offensive player and they are prevented from moving towards/with that player by another player, that defensive player may call “Pick”. However it is not a pick if both the player being guarded and the obstructing player are making a play on the disc at the time of the obstruction.
entries.zh: 如果一名防守队员正在防守一名进攻队员，且因另一名队员的妨碍而无法朝该进攻队员移动或跟随，则该防守队员可以示意“阻挡”违例。但在阻挡发生的时候，如果被防守的进攻队员和造成阻碍的队员都在尝试触盘，则此情况不构成阻挡违例。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: Prior to making the “Pick” call, the defender may delay the call up to two (2) seconds to determine if the obstruction will affect the play.
entries.zh: 在示意“阻挡”违例前，防守队员最多可延迟 2 秒再进行示意，判断该阻碍是否会对比赛产生影响。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: If play has stopped, the obstructed player may move to the agreed position they would have otherwise occupied if the obstruction had not occurred, unless specified otherwise.
entries.zh: 如果比赛停止，被阻挡的队员可以移动到如果阻挡没有发生他所在的位置，这个位置是需要双方认可的，除非另有规定。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: All players should take reasonable efforts to avoid the occurrence of picks.
entries.zh: 所有队员应努力避免阻挡违例发生。

entries.title: 违规与违例
entries.en: During any stoppage opposing players may agree to slightly adjust their locations to avoid potential picks.
entries.zh: 在比赛中断期间，双方队员可协商适度调整位置，避免可能发生的阻挡。

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: Injury Stoppage
entries.zh: 受伤中断

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: An injury stoppage, “Injury”, may be called by the injured player, or by any player on the injured player’s team.
entries.zh: 受伤中断（“受伤”）可以由受伤的队员或受伤队员一方的任意队员示意。

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: If the injury was not caused by an opponent, the player must choose either to be substituted, or to charge their own team with a time-out.
entries.zh: 如果受伤不是由对方队员造成的，则受伤队员必须选择被替换或使用本方队伍一次暂停。

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: If the injury was caused by an opponent, the player may choose to stay or to be substituted.
entries.zh: 如果受伤是由对方队员造成的，受伤队员可以选择继续比赛或被替换。

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: If the injured player had established possession of the disc, and the player has dropped the disc due to the injury, that player retains possession of the disc.
entries.zh: 如果受伤队员获得盘权且因伤掉盘，该队员保留盘权。

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: The injury stoppage is considered to have been called at the time of the injury, unless the injured player chooses to continue play before the stoppage is called.
entries.zh: 受伤中断被视为在受伤时做出的，除非受伤队员在中断比赛前选择继续比赛。

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: If the disc was in the air when the injury stoppage was called, play continues until either a player establishes possession, or the disc hits the ground. If the injury is not the result of a foul by an opponent, the completion or turnover stands, and play restarts there after the stoppage.
entries.zh: 如果示意受伤中断时盘在空中，比赛继续进行，直至有队员获得盘权或飞盘落地。如果受伤不是对手犯规导致，那么接盘或攻防转换有效，比赛在中断后重新开始。

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: Technical Stoppage
entries.zh: 技术中断

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: Any player who recognises a condition that endangers players, including if a player has an open or bleeding wound, should call a technical stoppage by calling “technical” or “stop”. Play must stop immediately.
entries.zh: 任何队员意识到有危险情况时，包括队员有开放性或流血的伤口时，应该喊出 “技术中断”或“停”来示意技术中断，比赛应该立刻停止。

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: A team-mate, coach, or designated official, should actively alert players to any condition that endangers players.

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: A player who has an issue regarding an open or bleeding wound has seventy (70) seconds to effectively address the issue. If they need additional time to address the issue, they must choose either to be substituted, or to charge their own team with a time-out.
entries.zh: 有开放性或流血伤口的队员有 70 秒时间快速处理伤口或者止血。如需额外的时间处理，队员必须选择被替换或使用本方队伍一次暂停。

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: The thrower may call a technical stoppage during play to replace a severely damaged disc.
entries.zh: 持盘队员可在比赛中示意技术中断，以更换严重损坏的飞盘。

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: After a technical stoppage called while the disc is in the air, or if play has continued unknowingly:
entries.zh: 如果示意技术中断时飞盘在空中或比赛在不知情的情况下继续进行：

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: If the call or issue did not affect play, the completion or turnover stands, and play restarts there;
entries.zh: 如果该示意或情况未影响比赛，则接盘或攻防转换有效，比赛从飞盘所在位置重新开始。

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: If the call or issue did affect the play, the disc goes back to the thrower.
entries.zh: 如果该示意或事件影响了比赛，飞盘应回到持盘队员手中。

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: If a player is substituted after an injury, or due to illegal or faulty equipment, the opposing team may also choose to substitute one player.
entries.zh: 如果队员因受伤、装备不符合规定或装备损坏被替换，对方队伍也可以选择替换一名队员。

entries.title: 安全中断
entries.en: Substitute players take on the full state (location, possession, stall count etc) of the player they are substituting and may make a call on their behalf.
entries.zh: 替换上场的队员将继承被替换队员的全部比赛状态（如位置、盘权、读秒等），并且可以代其进行示意。

entries.title: 暂停
entries.en: The player calling a time-out must form a “T” with their hands, or with one hand and the disc, and should call “time-out” to opposition players.
entries.zh: 示意暂停的队员必须用双手或一只手和飞盘组成一个“T”字，并向对方示意“暂停”。

entries.title: 暂停
entries.en: After the start of a point and before both teams have signalled readiness, a player from either team may call a time-out. The time-out extends the time between the start of the point and subsequent pull by seventy-five (75) seconds.
entries.zh: 在回合开始后，且双方未示意准备就绪前，任何一队的队员都可以示意暂停。暂停将回合开始到开盘之间的时间延长 75 秒。

entries.title: 暂停
entries.en: After the pull only a thrower with possession of the disc may call a time-out. The time-out starts when the “T” is formed, and lasts seventy-five (75) seconds. After such a time-out:
entries.zh: 开盘后，只有持盘队员持有飞盘时才可以示意暂停。暂停在形成“T”字时开始，持续 75 秒。暂停结束之后：

entries.title: 暂停
entries.en: Substitutions are not allowed, except for injury.
entries.zh: 除受伤外，不允许进行队员替换。

entries.title: 暂停
entries.en: Play is restarted at the pivot location.
entries.zh: 比赛在持盘队员的轴心位置重新开始。

entries.title: 暂停
entries.en: The thrower must remain the same.
entries.zh: 持盘队员必须与暂停前一致。

entries.title: 暂停
entries.en: All other offensive players must establish a stationary position, at any location.
entries.zh: 其他进攻队员可以在任何位置落位并必须保持静止。

entries.title: 暂停
entries.en: Once the offensive players have selected positions, defensive players must then establish a stationary position, at any location.
entries.zh: 进攻方确定落位后，防守方可以在任何位置落位并必须保持静止。

entries.title: 暂停
entries.en: The stall count restarts at maximum nine (9). However if the marker has been switched, the stall count restarts at “Stalling one (1)”.
entries.zh: 读秒从最高从 9 开始。如果更换了防盘队员，读秒应从“读秒 1”开始。

entries.title: 暂停
entries.en: If the thrower attempts to call a time-out while play is live and when their team has no remaining time-outs, play is stopped. The marker must add two (2) seconds to the stall count they would have restarted play on before restarting play with a check. If this results in a stall count of ten (10) or above, this is a “stall-out” turnover.
entries.zh: 如果持盘队员在活盘状态的比赛中示意暂停，但该队已无剩余暂停，比赛将停止。此时，防盘队员的原读秒将增加 2 秒，通过验盘重新开始比赛。如果读秒增加导致读秒达到或超过 10 秒，则视为“读秒超时”的攻防转换。

        出反应时 ，即视为在防守该进攻队员。

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Act of throwing: See throwing motion.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Affect the play: A breach or call affects the play if it is reasonable to assume that the outcome of the specific play may have been meaningfully different had the breach or call not occurred.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Attacking end zone: The end zone in which the team in question is currently attempting to score.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Best perspective: The most complete viewpoint available by a player that includes the relative position of the disc, ground, players and line markers involved in the play.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Call: A clearly communicated statement that a foul, infraction, violation, turnover or injury has occurred. The following terms may be used: Foul, Travel, specific name of Marking Infraction, Violation (or specific name of Violation), specific name of turnovers, Technical, and Injury.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Catch: A non-spinning disc trapped between at least two body parts. If a player initially catches a pass and then, prior to establishing possession, they do not maintain the catch (‘maintain the catch’ means to continue to have a non-spinning disc trapped between at least two body parts), that initial catch is deemed to have ended.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Central zone: The area of the playing field including the goal lines but excluding the end zones and the perimeter lines.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Defending end zone: The end zone in which the team in question is currently attempting to prevent the opposition from scoring.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Defensive player: Any player whose team is not in possession of the disc.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: End zone: One of the two areas at the end of the playing field where teams can score a goal by catching the disc there.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Goal line: The line separating the central zone from each end zone. It is not part of the end zone.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Ground: The ground consists of all substantial solid objects, including grass, marker cones, equipment, water, trees, fences, walls and non-players, but excluding all players and their worn clothing, airborne particles and precipitation.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Ground contact: Refers to all player contact with the ground directly related to a specific event or manoeuvre, including landing or recovery after being off-balance (e.g., jumping, diving, leaning, or falling).

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Guarding: A defender is guarding an offensive player when they are within three metres of that offensive player and are primarily focused on and reacting to that offensive player.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Interception: When a player on the defensive team establishes possession of a throw by a player on the offensive team.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Legitimate position: The stationary or moving position established by a player that is not in breach of any rules.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Line: A boundary defining the playing areas. On an unlined field, the boundary is defined as an imaginary line between two field markers with the thickness of said markers. Line segments are not extrapolated beyond the defining markers.

entries.ref: Making a play on the disc
entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Making a play on the disc: When the disc is in the air and a player is attempting to make contact with the disc in any way e.g. to catch it or block it. This includes the process of running towards the place they expect to make contact with the disc.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Marker: The defensive player who may call the stall count on the thrower.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Minor contact: Contact that involves minimal physical force and does not alter the movements or position of another player. Contact with an opponent’s extended arms or hands that are about to, or already are, contacting the disc, or contact to the throwers hand during the throwing motion, is not considered to be minor contact.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Non-player: Any person, including a team member, who is not currently a player.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Offensive player: A player whose team is in possession of the disc.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Out-of-bounds (OB): Everything that is not part of the playing field, including the perimeter lines.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Perimeter lines: Lines separating the central zone or end zone from the out-of-bounds area. They are not part of the playing field.

entries.title: 名词定义 · Definitions
entries.en: Pivot: When the thrower moves in any direction while keeping one part of their body in constant contact with a specific point on the ground called the pivot point. A thrower establishes a pivot point by placing, or keeping, a particular part of their body at a specific point, which they intend to use as their pivot point.
